notes: v1.3.0 aligns the tracked Spec Kit baseline to 1.0.12 and the audited Superpowers baseline to 6.4.2. It reports malformed extension registries per the current Spec Kit hook contract and adapts checkbox-based Spec Kit tasks to the Task N headings required by Superpowers 6.4.2 using disposable execution scaffolding. The v1.3.0 public ZIP passed Linux, Windows, and macOS release gates; the WSL2 sibling sandbox completed a full handoff cycle. The bridge preserves three commands, five hooks, handoff v1, guard rules, actor semantics, the stable-alias URL, and the >=0.8.10 runtime floor.
